scripts.installAll: cross-env npm install && npm run install:tabs
scripts.azure-local-setup: cross-env npx @microsoft/teamsfx-cli account login azure && npx @microsoft/teamsfx-cli account set --subscription ff4fdd30-08ff-40e8-9225-720c1f964f08
scripts.package: cross-env npx @microsoft/teamsfx-cli manifest validate && npx @microsoft/teamsfx-cli package
scripts.publish-app: cross-env npm run package && npx @microsoft/teamsfx-cli deploy && npx @microsoft/teamsfx-cli publish
